messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert -> svc=sable-prod-eu; 30% error rate on dedicated pool for tenant SABLE. Incident ID: INC-20260315-045

sre-oncall: Paging in. Seeing 5xx from /v1/generate for tenant SABLE (dedicated pool). Confirmed increased latency + errors. I'm taking lead.

alex_p: Oncall handoff incoming? I'm next after 02:00 UTC. Current plan?

sre-oncall: Quick summary: partial network fabric flapping in eu-west-1 caused backend replicas to drop connections. Sable's dedicated VPC saw traffic to degraded hosts. Plan: 1) warm capacity in eu-central-1 (ops-lead). 2) staged traffic shift via route policy (netinfra). 3) DNS TTL management for VIP swap and customer comms (maria-cs). 4) KV cache warm to reduce cold-start errors.

ops-lead: Spinning up warm capacity now: `rctl create pool --region=eu-central-1 --type=dedicated --pool=sable-warm --size=6` ETA ~7m

netinfra: Will apply staged routing policy: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m observation windows. Pushing config: `routectl apply --tenant=SABLE --policy=staged --steps=5,20,50,100 --failover=eu-central-1`

deploy-bot: Deploy job started to warm pool images. Job ID: deploy-7890. Streaming logs.

maria-cs: Notifying Sable support ops: 'We see degraded service in eu-west-1; shifting traffic to eu-central-1. Expect intermittent errors for up to 30m.' Customer acknowledged; asked about TTL.

sre-oncall: For DNS, TTL currently 60s. We'll reduce to 30s pre-cut then raise to 300s post-stable. Change via edge-dns API:
```bash
edge-dns update --zone=sable.example.com --record=vip --ttl=30
```

netinfra: Applied 5% reroute. Monitoring metrics now.

sre-oncall: Observability tail (sample):
```text
502 gateway timeout --> backend=host-17
latency p95 jumped 80ms -> 420ms
```

alex_p: Ready to take over monitoring and escalation after handoff. @sre-oncall can you paste the runbook pointer?

sre-oncall: Runbook: /runbooks/tenant-failover (link). Key steps: warm pool, routectl staged shift, DNS swap, KV cache warming: `primectl warm --tenant=SABLE --models=all --concurrency=3`

eng-runtime: KV cache warming started in eu-central-1, progress ~40%. Model shards priming, quantization profiles consistent.

ops-lead: Warm pool report: instances booted, health checks passing ~90% after priming. ETA ready ~6m.

netinfra: Moving to 20% traffic. Error rate trending down to ~6% for tenant SABLE.

maria-cs: Customer asked about data plane isolation. Confirming traffic stays in dedicated VPC and logs retained; informing compliance contact.

sre-oncall: DNS propagation check (mixed results):
```text
; <<>> DiG 9.16.1 <<>> vip.sable.example.com
;; ANSWER SECTION:
vip.sable.example.com. 30 IN A 10.2.3.5
```
Some edges still return old IPs.

netinfra: Proceeding to 50% now. Watching for error spikes and latency.

eng-runtime: Noted a regression on one model shard at host-22; routing will bypass if error threshold exceeded. Keeping an eye.

alex_p: Handoff: I'm now primary for monitoring. @ops-lead keep me posted on pool size; @netinfra on percentages; @maria-cs on customer comms.

ops-lead: Ack. Pool stable; 8 instances healthy.

incident-bot: Reminder: Incident INC-20260315-045 severity SEV2. Please update incident doc.

maria-cs: Customer update sent: 'We've shifted traffic to eu-central-1 for your dedicated pool; some users may have experienced errors for ~18m; overall service restored. We'll follow up with RCA.'

sre-oncall: 100% traffic shifted. Error rate back to baseline. Starting postmortem draft and incident timeline.

alex_p: I'll monitor for 1h then propose closure if stable.

deploy-bot: deploy-7890 completed successfully; images rolled; no drift detected.

sre-oncall: Closing notes: preliminary root cause = transient fabric flap in eu-west-1 that degraded dedicated pool hosts. Mitigations performed: staged traffic shift, DNS TTL management, warm pool priming, KV cache warming. Action items: auto pre-warm enterprise pools on fiber alarms, increase health-check granularity, adjust default VIP TTL behavior during incidents.

maria-cs: Filing customer follow-up and exec summary.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-045 marked RESOLVED at 1812345940.
